title: Record Decision Rationale Output
description: Skipped is the default and is a complete answer.

recorded.description: False when the health worker did not opt in; nothing else is then written.

provenance.description: FHIR R4 Provenance (https://hl7.org/fhir/R4/provenance.html): target the request (or RequestGroup), agent the practitioner, entity source the PlanDefinition, reason the coded or free-text reason.
